english:
My name is Mariya Shaini. Our real home is Kozhenchery, Pathanamthitta, but we live in Kuwait.
We had a total leave of about 10 days — 10 to 15 days — and we came back home. The reason we came then was because my dad and mom were in bad health,
so we came to see them and to show them the little one. But this is my testimony: our eldest daughter Jessa — she was 12 years old,
and after she turned 12 we had our second child. I had taken a covenant on 23/7/2024 and then returned to Kuwait.
After going there and staying, I conceived my second child within three months. But I really wanted a second child.
We wanted another child, but I had many physical difficulties and various complications at that time - spondylosis and other issues.
I never imagined we would have a second child like this, but whenever I read the Bible I kept receiving a verse about childbirth — about Elizabeth’s pregnancy —
that line about the birth of children kept coming to me, and I would think about it.
I wondered why I was receiving this, but Mother showed me that I conceived on October 6th. That day I thought, “God…”
“How will I go forward?” I had severe spondylosis. I had already put this intention in my covenant, and I was praying, and then...
Even though the pain came occasionally, after I conceived it never returned. My Mother prepared me for all of this.
With prayer, our family always did evening prayers and morning prayers together. Because of that, Mother blessed us and gave us this child.
Through a normal delivery, God blessed us with this baby boy.
My second testimony is about my daughter. She always had fever, stomach aches, and vomiting. Whenever she had an empty stomach,
if she went to church or anywhere else, on the way back she would always vomit. I remember thinking, why does this happen? We would always have to go to the hospital,
put her on a drip, and only then would she recover. Even if she had a fever, it wouldn’t go away without the drip. So I made a covenant to Mother and prayed:
“Mother, let it not be that every time we need to go to the hospital for a drip to
recover.” I even called here and asked, and they told me that using the covenant items would be enough.
By using the covenant items, Mother removed my daughter’s fever, vomiting, and stomach ache. I give a thousand crore thanks to Mother and the Holy Son.
Third, my testimony is this: last year, when we went home and returned, at the airport our luggage count went over. It wasn’t the luggage weight,
but the number of baggage items. Instead of three, we had five bags.
At that time, they told us, “If you want to proceed, you will have to pay 22 thousand rupees at the airport; otherwise, you cannot move forward.”
But we had only a few minutes left to complete our travel. Truly, we cried, got angry, and it was very stressful there.
That day, I told my Mother: “There are a few issues close to the covenant, but Mother, I call and pray
to you every morning and evening — why are you not seeing this? We didn’t even notice this luggage problem ourselves.”
Suddenly, I felt in my heart — as if someone was telling me — “Use the covenant salt.” Quickly, I placed it without anyone seeing it on the luggage.
Immediately, we managed to clear one bag, shift its contents to another, empty it, and hold it by hand.
Still, we had one bag left with us. For that, they said, “Only if you pay 11,000 rupees can you proceed.”
We had only a few minutes to catch the flight. We had to release the luggage, then clear security, and only then could we reach the gate.
At that moment, when they demanded 11,000 rupees for one package, suddenly the officer checked the computer and told us: “Now your balance shows zero.”
No matter how much thanks I give to Mother, it will never be enough.
They initially said we had to pay 11,000 rupees for that one bag, but then suddenly the computer showed zero balance.
The officer changed from being a very strict and angry person to a cool person, but even there, Mother did not leave us; She helped us and guided us.
Many, many miracles like this happened in our lives.
Since this child was born, we have always gone to church and confess, all faithfully. That’s how our son was born.
We used all the covenant items. I would apply the covenant oil on my belly, make the sign of the cross, and pray — and similarly…
For others, for those who don’t have children, I would apply the covenant oil on my belly and pray.
The result of that is that Mother worked mercifully for us. As for charitable works, We went to places like Providential Home and other institutions where children were without care.
We would give them food or help them with whatever needs they had.
Otherwise, if we were in Kuwait, we wouldn’t have had food to give anyone; that would have been a problem. But still, whenever I could, I prepared food packets for those in need.
There were several hungry people, and I would prepare meals at lunchtime, pack them, and take them to them. For missionary work, so to say,
Besides that, I have helped many people. Whenever someone came forward with a need, we helped them. Yes, we do share it — like Father’s Our Daily Bread.
Our family participates in that prayer every day. Then there is meditation on Tuesday; I also share that.
I sometimes post it as a status. Many see it, many comment. There is an elder sister as our relative; she came here and was able to take a covenant. That was a great blessing.
She had no home, and after taking the covenant here, she was able to get a home. Many, many blessings like this we received through Mother, through the Holy Mother.
I give a thousand crore thanks to the Holy Mother and the Holy Son. Psalm 45, verse 17:
“Through generations, your name will be praised; nations will glorify you forever.” This is a testimony of Maria in witness to the apparition.
In 2024, this daughter went and took a covenant here. Within a short three-month period, after 12 years, she received her second child —
a child she had been longing and praying for. Very quickly, by the grace of the Holy Spirit, she was blessed with this child.
For all childrenless couples and those troubled by not having children, they prayed and offered their intentions to Jesus and the Holy Mother, and the Holy Mother gave them a child.
By receiving grace from Jesus, their incapabilities were turned into blessings. This is a great miracle testimony of time-shortening. Mother journeyed with them.
The Mother accompanied them, just as she removed all fever and discomfort from the eldest daughter, creating an atmosphere of comfort in their family.
